c87834549.notes: Garden-path name plate on a post in the Sir Seewoosagur Ramgoolam Botanical Garden, Pamplemousses; garden logo and small header above the avenue name.

c87863491.notes: Same plate design as c87834549 but a different avenue; close-up, very sharp.

c87794164.notes: Wet, slightly cracked plate; a palm frond crosses the right side and 'MAURITIUS' is faint. Sign abbreviates Henry to 'H.'.

c87819838.notes: Partly faded lettering (the middle of 'Étienne F. Le' is washed out); accent on É is present.

c158859638.reason: pictogram (don't sit on turtles), no text

c24279556.notes: Roadside board in a log frame with bird logo and an arrow panel below; name is all lower case. Photographer watermark 'CARROTMADMAN6' tiny in the corner only.

c74913499.notes: Brown heritage-site board in Mauritian Creole (World Heritage Site, Le Morne Cultural Landscape, respect it). Small UNESCO and Le Morne Heritage Trust Fund logos at bottom left. lang mfe = Morisyen (no ISO 639-1 code).

c24279579.reason: trespass warning notice (Airports of Mauritius), no place name as target

c65951362.notes: Weathered banner on a wooden frame in mid-distance, partly hidden by palms: the leading 'V' of Vallée and the end of 'Gardens' are covered by fronds (visible text transcribed). Opening-hours lines below are tiny.

c72487831.notes: Raised gold letters on a basalt wall at an angle, Phoenix; strong shadows behind the letters make the Devanagari third word harder. India/Mauritius flag-ribbon logo at left.

c167952948.notes: Painted blue village welcome sign with a beach/parasailing scene (2025). 'MAX SHOP' signs on buildings down the road are distractors.

c24884920.reason: multilingual interpretive text panel about the waterfall, not a name sign

c167951884.reason: near-duplicate of c167952948 (same Trou aux Biches sign, wider view)

c25721587.notes: Older (2013) white welcome board with blue and orange letters, a different physical sign from c167952948.

f9606b88a-d4be-4a23-b1d7-66214f9c6fc2.reason: generic SORTIE/EXIT direction sign, no place name
